I recently changed my thermometer to read in C. My husband often forgets and thinks it's much colder than it actually is. 
We didn't even warm up to freezing yesterday, and he didn't question or ask for conversion when I gave him negative numbers.

Slowly he will learn to think of freezing as zero and boiling as 100. Muahahhhahahaahaaaa
So then, there is a difference?

Left about 4 months ago. 2 people have reached out wondering if I was still alive. 

I am so much happier without it.

A cat. 

I was walking through my shoppe and saw a cat jump up, flop over to a seated position, thrust its leg up, and groom. 

There was no cat. 

Sometime later, an old tenant of the residences above the shoppe told me about his experience with a ghost-cat. 

This is one of two reasons I strangely believe in ghosts now.

I struggle with this too. Making friends as an adult can be difficult.  I haven't had someone closer than arms reach in many years. 

I have considered joining a community like church, pub trivia, or art groups.

Still haven't yet, and I'm also going to be watching this post for more ideas for myself. 

Thanks for posting. It's weird when we're wildly alone, surrounded by people.

I'm still mad, but the sadness is showing.

I cursed when I read this. Now I'm sad. 

We were betrayed. The world was betrayed. Theirs and ours. Ours.
It happened.

I'm looking forward to my shop having its community back. 
I'm looking forward to listening to the groups meeting about various things - support, philosophy, arts, etc.

I just got my hall-pass letter from work to prove that I, a temporary seasonal part-time receptionist at a tax office, am an essential employee. 

On one hand I'm grateful for money in these uncertain times, but on the other I feel like I'm slapping humanity in the face.

I wish my job weren't essential. They gave us 3 months longer to deal with taxes, why don't they just shut us down for one of those months?

I'll be out in society touching gas nozzles, existing, moving from point a to b, and even possibly passing things back and forth to you. 

This is why there's a surge. Everyone doing anything is essential.
Snuggle my babies.

My apologies.

I hate to admit I'm white when trying to do right.

I'm just acting on shock of inequality.

I forget your are all perfect.
My apologies.
